name: byte-resource-verification
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,datetime,re
p=Path.cwd();expected='4a988841cea7ae83f8999b9d81b7f6dcb273e4cd1a94d4df92bc622ecbcc2b3a'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert sha((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==(p/'reservation.sha256').read_text().strip()==expected
raw=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records'];r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert len(raw)==len(r)==20;assert set(raw)==set(r)==set(map(str,json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']))
chunks={};checks={};cor=(p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus').resolve()
for k,v in raw.items():
 f=Path(v['chunk_path']);assert f.parent.resolve()==cor and re.fullmatch(r'mathdb-normalized-chunk-\d+\.jsonl',f.name)
 if str(f) not in chunks:
  b=f.read_bytes();chunks[str(f)]=(sha(b),b.splitlines(keepends=True))
 h,lines=chunks[str(f)];line=lines[v['one_based_line']-1];assert sha(line)==v['raw_sha256'];assert base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64'])==line;assert line.endswith(b'\n');assert h==v['chunk_sha256'];o=json.loads(line);assert o==v['original_object'];assert sha(o['statement'].encode())==v['decoded_utf8_statement_sha256'];assert sha(json.dumps(o,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode())==v['object_sha256_canonical_json'];assert r[k]['literal_statement']==o['statement'];assert r[k]['credit']==0
 checks[k]={'raw_bytes':len(line),'newline_hex':line[-2:].hex(),'raw_sha256':sha(line),'original_chunk_rechecked':True,'statement_and_object_verified':True}
(p/'byte-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reservation_sha256':expected,'reservation_pair_matches':True,'exact20_ids':True,'raw_checks':checks,'chunks_rechecked':{f:v[0] for f,v in chunks.items()},'count_unchanged':'52/60','credit':0},indent=2)+'\n')
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());receipts.append({'path':f.name,'sha256':sha(f.read_bytes()),'name':o.get('name'),'exit':o.get('exit',o.get('returncode')),'wall_s':o.get('wall_s'),'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':o.get('sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'),'child_cpu_cumulative_s':o.get('child_cpu_cumulative_s'),'killed':o.get('killed')})
(p/'resource-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed_receipts_at_this_stage':receipts,'terminal_receipts':'This call and manifest/terminal calls finish afterward and are included in final manifest except explicit terminal self-exclusions.','caps':'provided run.py CPU affinity2,childCPU115,supervisorCPU120,AS6GiB,arena2,sampledRSS6GiB,deadline130,outer140','limits':'sampled RSS can miss short-lived writers; child cumulativeCPU is not aggregate CPU enforcement; receipt-writing processes lack separate RSS measurement; no cgroup or universal compliance claim','subprocess_reaping':'All source converters subprocess.run waited; fetch pools used context managers and joined; runner communicate/wait reaps each source/writer process. No background or orphan research jobs launched.','mathematical_execution':False,'formal_execution':False,'children':False},indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: original 20 JSONL lines, newline/chunk/object/statement hashes, keyed results, zero credit, reservation pair. Completed receipts:',len(receipts))
print('own top-level names',sorted(f.name for f in p.iterdir() if f.is_file()))
